name: HOSTFLOW

desc:
HOSTFLOW is a digital Google Sheets operations system designed for independent hosts managing 1–5 short-term rental properties.

It brings booking records, turnover planning, maintenance tracking, paid expenses, occupancy, revenue and profitability reporting into one structured workbook.

HOSTFLOW helps small operators organize everyday tasks and maintain a clearer overview of their properties without relying on multiple disconnected spreadsheets.

bbio: I'm Anyell Guirado, founder of Lodgeline Studio. I create practical Google Sheets templates that help small short-term rental hosts organize bookings, cleaning turnovers, expenses and daily operations.
bstory:
I created HOSTFLOW to help independent hosts managing 1–5 short-term rentals keep their daily operations organized without relying on multiple disconnected spreadsheets.

Bookings, cleaning turnovers, maintenance tasks and paid expenses are closely related, but tracking them separately can make it difficult to maintain a clear overview.

My goal was to bring these activities together in a practical Google Sheets system that is easy to understand and helps small operators stay organized without needing complex property management software.

name: FixMyExport
tagline: Fix Snapchat My Data exports.
desc: FixMyExport (formerly Export Snaps) processes Snapchat My Data exports on your device. It restores supported capture dates, time, and GPS, can merge paired overlays, and can stitch supported split videos so Memories import cleanly into Apple Photos, Google Photos, and other galleries. Photos and videos are never sent to FixMyExport servers. Optional Google Drive / Dropbox sends finished files from your device to your own account. Freemium: free 200 files / 3 attempts; Pro $14.99 one-time unlimited local on one device; $19.99 for cloud upload. Platforms: macOS 12+, Windows 10 1809+, iOS/iPadOS 15.1+, Android 7.0+.
bbio: Kazi Hasan Ali is the founder of FixMyExport, a local-first tool that repairs Snapchat My Data exports on-device. He builds privacy-respecting media utilities so personal photos and videos keep their dates, location, and story without uploading memories to a third-party processing server.
bstory: I built FixMyExport after helping back up Snapchat Memories and discovering the export left files hard to use in real photo libraries: wrong or missing dates, no map GPS, separated overlays, and split video segments. I wanted a straightforward on-device app so personal memories could be fixed without uploading photos and videos to a processing server. Local processing first; cloud destinations only as an optional path from the device to the user's own Drive or Dropbox.
